look: Guided cursor over real screenshots: the actual OmniOrders screens in a browser window, a gliding cursor, ripple on click, typing revealed in place. Captions sit on a dark plate.

scenes.name: How-to

scenes.name: Ask Claude

scenes.name: Claude builds it

scenes.name: Export

scenes.name: Voice
scenes.desc: ElevenLabs: Matilda picked; one caption pasted into Text to Speech; Generate speech.

scenes.name: Mix
scenes.desc: Back in Claude: plus, Upload or add files; the prompt asking Claude to put each clip under its caption.

scenes.name: Done
